svg.title: Example backend stack
svg.desc: BACKEND: Java, Spring Boot, Jakarta EE (Java EE), Hibernate. Web APIs / authentication / persistence; JUnit / Mockito / Testcontainers. BUILD & VERSIONING: Maven, Gradle, Git. DATA & MESSAGING: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ. Migrations: Liquibase; Integration: Spring Kafka / Spring AMQP / gRPC Java. DELIVERY: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions.
svg.text: Integration: Spring Kafka / Spring AMQP / gRPC Java
